mapper.select:
select t.table_name, t.engine, t.table_comment, t.create_time from information_schema.tables t where t.table_schema = (select database())
and t.table_name like concat('%', #{query.tableName}, '%')
and t.table_comment like concat('%', #{tableComment}, '%')
ORDER BY ${sorter}

select t.table_name, null as engine, t.comments as table_comment, t.created as create_time from user_tables t
and upper(t.table_name) like '%' || upper(#{query.tableName}) || '%'
and upper(t.comments) like '%' || upper(#{tableComment}) || '%'
ORDER BY ${sorter}
select table_name, engine, table_comment, create_time from information_schema.tables where table_schema = (select database()) and table_name = #{tableName}

select column_name, data_type, column_type, column_comment, column_key, extra from information_schema.columns where table_name = #{tableName} and table_schema = (select database()) order by ordinal_position
select table_name, null as engine, comments as table_comment, created as create_time from user_tables where upper(table_name) = upper(#{tableName})

select column_name, data_type, data_type as column_type, comments as column_comment, case when constraint_type = 'P' then 'PRI' else '' end as column_key, '' as extra from user_tab_columns c left join ( select cc.column_name, con.constraint_type from user_constraints con join user_cons_columns cc on con.constraint_name = cc.constraint_name where con.table_name = upper(#{tableName}) ) pk on c.column_name = pk.column_name where upper(c.table_name) = upper(#{tableName}) order by c.column_id
